name: better-interface
title_zh: 六路质检合一，界面挑刺不重样
tagline_zh: 可访问性、排版、文案、字体、配色、细节打磨，一次全查。适合上线前最后一关，专治自己看不出毛病。
tagline_en: Accessibility, layout, writing, typography, color, polish—one sweep. The last gate before launch, for blind spots.
desc_en: Combines all of the `better-*` skills into a single review across accessibility, layout, writing, typography, color and UI polish.
why_zh: 不是简单拼盘，而是交叉复查：同一处问题可能同时触发多条规则，输出带优先级，让你先改最扎眼的。
why_en: Not a bundle—it cross-checks: one flaw can trip multiple lenses, output is prioritized, so you fix what stings first.
limit_zh: 只审静态界面截图或代码片段，不跑交互流程；需要你提供清晰截图或源码文本，否则它只能泛泛而谈。
limit_en: Static screenshots or code snippets only—no interaction flows. Blurry input yields generic advice, not specifics.
